dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Warriors of the Flower-Feather Clan, thank you for all that you have given, and all that you have sacrificed. It is through your deeds that victory was won."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "From the day of this announcement, the Flower-Feather Clan is no longer in a state of war. The peacetime rules of the Flight Trial are hereby reinstated."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Members of the flying squad should change shifts according to the new patrol and training plans."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The Abyss may have been defeated, but other dangers may rise in its wake. Remain vigilant, and never forget your pride as warriors. Always remember to hone your skills."
